name: Xirakis, Adult Pact Dragon

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Pledged Rider
traits.details: When mounted by a friendly rider of 13th level or higher, any damage dealt to Xirakis can be redirected to its rider, and vice versa.

traits.name: Skirmish +2d6
traits.details: If, on its turn, Xirakis ends its move at least 4 squares away from its starting point, it deals 2d6 extra damage with its melee attacks until the start of its next turn.

powers.name: Ripping Charger
powers.requirements: when mounted by a friendly rider of 13th level or higher

effect.description: When it charges, Xirakis can make two claw attacks and one bite attack; each must be against a different foe.

powers.name: Wing Buffet
powers.trigger: when an enemy moves to flank Xirakis

hit.description: damage, the target is knocked prone, and the dragon shifts 2 squares
fire damage, and the target takes ongoing 5 fire damage (save ends)

effect.description: The dragon’s breath weapon recharges, and the dragon uses it immediately.
Xirakis disappears into the Astral Sea, teleporting 10 squares. Its rider teleports with it.
